title: Jeff McAulay (clean energy operator) — 'This may be the most importabt business book of my professional career'
summary: Jeff McAulay — clean-energy operator — hears Eric on a podcast in the morning, buys the audiobook on the train, then a hardcover in NYC, and posts that Incorruptible may be the most important business book of his professional career.
blockquote:
I'm obsessed with this book. I first heard a podcast with the author Eric Ries this morning. I immediately got the audiobook while still on the train and then had to get a hard copy in NYC.

This may be the most importabt business book of my professional career. Everybody remembers The Lean Startup. This is much more important.

This book says so many things better than I have been saying them. Non-profit vs for-profit is a false dichotomy- it's about what you do with those profits. Even more it highlights the structural mechanisms for how to protect corporate missions for the long term with examples of companies that have done so at scale.
